items.title: Using Excel for Data Analysis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Using Excel for Data Analysis' under topic 6.10 (PDF 88, printed 84).

blocks.text: Excel bunyadi data analysis ke liye bohat istemal hota hai; is mein data rows aur columns mein rakha jata hai. Excel mein sorting (tarteeb dena), filtering (sirf zaroori rows dikhana) aur charts se data visualization (data ko tasveer ki shakal mein dikhana) hoti hai. Charts data samajhne mein madad dete hain, aur saade formulas hisab karte hain. Excel seekhna asaan hai aur chhote datasets ke liye mufeed hai. Naye seekhne wale aksar Excel se shuru karte hain, aur yeh data ki ibtidai samajh deta hai.
